entries.title: Revelation of John 1:1
segments:
Of Jesus. From Jesus, the real author.
 

 
 Must. In order to fulfill divine purpose as foretold in prophecy.
 

 
 Signified. Revealed in signs and symbols; as in

.
 

 
 John. The apostle, son of Zebedee, author of the gospel and epistles.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:2
segments: Word of God. As received in this revelation.

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:3
segments: He that readeth. The public reader in the assembly of the saints.

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:4
segments: Seven churches. Those named in

.  These letters were addressed to these seven churches as having individually each its own problem, and also as representative of the varying conditions and problems of the whole church.  They typify the various local churches of Christendom in all ages, with their elements of strength and weakness; and there is in the message an element of progress, which seems to make them a sort of prophecy of the whose Christian age.
 

 
 Asia. The western part of what is now called Asia Minor; including Mysia, Lydia, Caria, and part of Phrygia.
 

 
 Seven Spirits. Commentators generally agree that the term signifies the Holy Spirit in His completeness.

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:5
segments: The faithful witness. Jesus came to bear witness unto the truth.  See

.
 

 
 Firstborn of the dead. The writer points out Jesus as the first victor over sin and death, the firstfruits of those who shall live and reign with him in glory.
 

 
 Loveth. A continuing action.
 

 
 Loosed. A completed act, in the death on the cross, whereby Christ redeemed mankind in his sublime sacrifice.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:6
segments: Priests. The kingdom is composed of those who offer spiritual sacrifices of prayer, praise, and service, to their Lord.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:7
segments: With the clouds. The imagery of the Son of man riding upon the clouds at his second coming is frequent throughout the Scriptures.  See

.
 

 
 They that pierced him. Not the Roman soldiers, but the Jews who crucified him.  See
.  The verse quotes the prophecy of Zechariah.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:8
segments: The Alpha and the Omega. The first and last letters of the Greek alphabet, expressing the beginning and the end.  He who speaks is the Eternal One.

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:9
segments: The tribulation. As foretold by Jesus. See

.
 

 
 Patmos. An island about 10 miles long and 6 miles wide, in the Aegean Sea, about 50 miles west of Miletus.
 

 
 For the word. John was probably banished to the isle of Patmos because of his faith in Jesus. It is possible, however, that he was bidden to go to the isle of Patmos in order to receive the revelation.

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:10
segments: In the Spirit. In a state of prophetic illumination.  See
.  Peter had a like experience (
), and so did Paul (

).
 

 
 The Lord's day. This may mean the first day of the week.  See
.  Or it may mean the final and great day of the Lord, to which he felt himself transported.  See

.
 

 
 Trumpet. The sound of the trumpet was a signal of the divine presence.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:11
segments: Seven churches. See notes on

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:12
segments: Seven golden candlesticks. Representing the seven churches.  See
; also

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:13
segments: A son of man. Having the figure of a man.  See

.
 

 
 Down to the foot. A garment indicative of priestly and regal dignity.

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:14
segments: White wool. This vision of John is similar in many details to the vision of Daniel.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:15
segments:
Brass. Either bronze, an alloy of copper and tin, or electrum- gold combined with silver, steel and bronze; brilliant when polished.
 

 
 Voice of many waters. Ezekiel also makes a like comparison of the voice of the almighty.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:16
segments: A sharp two-edged sword. Figurative language to express the convincing and convicting word of the Spirit.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:17
segments:
As one dead. Overcome by fear in the presence of the divine majesty.
 

 
 Fear not. John had passed through a similar experience at the transfiguration, and with almost the same words Jesus restored his confidence.  See

.
 

 
 The first and the last. Eternal; from everlasting to everlasting.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:18
segments:
The Living one. That is, living from all eternity, before time was, both before and after he came into the world to redeem it.
 

 
 Keys of death and of Hades. Symbols of his authority over death and the realm of the dead.

entries.title: Revelation of John 1:20
segments:
Mystery. Truth formerly hidden, but now to be revealed.
 

 
 Angels. Symbolic representations or types of the churches themselves; or possibly the responsible heads ('bishops') of the churches.
